description: This file implements the OpenCDMSessionPrivate class, which manages DRM session lifecycle, key management, challenge data handling, and protection metadata integration for a media playback system. It interacts with backend DRM components and handles license requests, session loading, updating, and key status updates.

classes.name: OpenCDMSessionPrivate
classes.description: A class that manages DRM session lifecycle, key management, challenge data, and protection metadata for media playback, interfacing with backend DRM components and handling license requests and key status updates.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the DRM session, creating a key session via the backend if not already initialized.

methods.name: generateRequest
methods.description: Generates a license request for the specified init data type and data.

methods.name: loadSession
methods.description: Loads an existing DRM session based on session ID.

methods.name: updateSession
methods.description: Updates the DRM session with a license.

methods.name: getChallengeData
methods.description: Retrieves challenge data for license acquisition, waiting if necessary.

methods.name: addProtectionMeta
methods.description: Adds protection metadata to a GstBuffer, including encryption info and key IDs.

methods.name: closeSession
methods.description: Closes the DRM session.

methods.name: removeSession
methods.description: Removes the DRM session.

methods.name: containsKey
methods.description: Checks if a key ID is contained within the session.

methods.name: setDrmHeader
methods.description: Sets the DRM header for the session.

methods.name: selectKeyId
methods.description: Selects a specific key ID for PlayReady.

methods.name: onLicenseRequest
methods.description: Handles license request events, updating challenge data and invoking callback.

methods.name: onLicenseRenewal
methods.description: Handles license renewal events, updating challenge data and invoking callback.

methods.name: updateChallenge
methods.description: Updates internal challenge data and notifies waiting threads.

methods.name: onKeyStatusesChanged
methods.description: Handles key status updates and invokes callbacks.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Returns the current status of a key.

methods.name: getSessionId
methods.description: Returns the current session ID.

methods.name: initializeCdmKeySessionId
methods.description: Initializes the internal CDM key session ID from backend.

methods.name: getLastDrmError
methods.description: Retrieves the last DRM error code.

methods.name: getRialtoSessionType
methods.description: Converts LicenseType to Rialto KeySessionType.

methods.name: getRialtoInitDataType
methods.description: Converts string init data type to Rialto InitDataType.
